description: This file contains implementations of big number division functions, including BN_div and BN_mod, which perform division and modulus operations on large integers in cryptographic computations.

methods.name: int BN_div(BIGNUM * dv,BIGNUM * rm,const BIGNUM * num,const BIGNUM * divisor,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Performs division of large numbers, computing quotient and remainder.

methods.name: int BN_mod(BIGNUM * rem,const BIGNUM * m,const BIGNUM * d,BN_CTX * ctx)
methods.description: Calculates modulus of large numbers, effectively a division remainder operation.
